**Documentation Template (Copy/Paste; Consistent Order)**

```
Date & Time: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] – Record when the event/conversation occurred (not when you wrote the note).
Location/Channel: [In-person/Zoom/Phone/Email/Chat + where] – Identify the medium and setting.
Participants: [Name (Role), Name (Role)] – List people directly involved in the interaction.
Summary (1–2 lines): [What happened] – State the topic/issue in plain, factual terms.
Direct Quotes: [“…”] – Use quotation marks only for words you are confident were said verbatim.
Paraphrased Statements: [PARAPHRASE] […] – Use [PARAPHRASE] for anything not verbatim and keep it faithful and minimal.
Your Response/Action: […] – Record what you said/did (observable actions, not motives).
Documents/Artifacts Referenced: […] – Note any relevant doc/meeting name without copying confidential content.
Witnesses: [OMIT if silent] – Omit silent attendees; this prevents implying their observation or endorsement of your recollection and reduces unnecessary drag-in if this becomes a PIP.
Outcome/Next Step: […] – Record what was agreed (or that nothing was agreed) and any follow-up you plan.
```
